name: beehiiv
label: Beehiiv
description: Manage subscriptions and automations in Beehiiv

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Your can obtain API key by naviating to **Settings->Workspace Settings-> API**.

create_subscription.label: Create Subscription

email.label: Email
email.description: The email address of the new subscription.

reactivate_existing.label: Reactivate Existing
reactivate_existing.description: Whether to reactivate the subscription if they have already unsubscribed. Use only if the subscription is knowingly resubscribing.

send_welcome_email.label: Send Welcome Email
send_welcome_email.description: Whether to send the default welcome email to the subscription.

utm_campaign.label: UTM Campaign
utm_campaign.description: The acquisition campaign of the subscription.

referring_site.label: Referring Site
referring_site.description: The website that the subscription was referred from.

referral_code.label: Referral Code
referral_code.description: A subscription's referral_code to give them credit for the new subscription.

custom_fields.label: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom field values by their display name, such as {"Company": "Acme"}.

stripe_customer_id.label: Stripe Customer ID
stripe_customer_id.description: The Stripe customer ID for this subscription.

double_opt_override.label: Double Opt-in Override
double_opt_override.description: Override publication double-opt settings for this subscription.

premium_tier_ids.label: Premium Tier IDs
premium_tier_ids.description: The IDs of the premium tiers this subscription is associated with.

automation_ids.label: Automation IDs
automation_ids.description: Enroll the subscription into automations after their subscription has been created.

update_subscription.label: Update Subscription

tier.label: Subscription Tier
tier.description: Set the tier for this subscription.

stripe_customer_id.label: Stripe Customer ID
stripe_customer_id.description: The Stripe Customer ID of the subscription.

unsubscribe.label: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.description: Whether to unsubscribe this subscription from the publication.

custom_fields.label: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom field values by their display name, such as {"Company": "Acme"}.

delete_subscription.label: Delete Subscription
delete_subscription.description: Permanently deletes a subscription from a Beehiiv publication.

add_subscription_to_automation.label: Add Subscription to Automation
add_subscription_to_automation.description: Adds an existing subscription to a specific automation flow.

email.label: Subscription Email
email.description: The email address of the subscription. Provide either Email or Subscription ID.

double_opt_override.label: Double Opt-in Override
double_opt_override.description: Override publication double-opt settings for this subscription (e.g., "on").

add_subscription_to_automation.beforeRequest:
if (!inputs.email && !inputs.subscription_id) throw new Error('Either Subscription Email or Subscription ID must be provided.');
return request;
